_doc: SHK has no level select of its own (its code checker is never called, and the level-select screen lives in the locked-on half): the settings menu's LEVEL SELECT starts the chosen stage - when Start leaves the title (game mode $FFF600 = $8C) the zone/act word $FFFE10 is set, before the level loads. Each start checked: game mode $0C, the zone kept, the player moving. The session keeps the poke (SESSION.poke) and replays with it.
